info.title: microsandbox cloud API
info.description: REST API for microsandbox cloud: sandbox and volume lifecycle, organization context, quotas, usage, and audit events, authenticated with an organization API key.

parameters.description: JSON object of labels to AND-match

parameters.description: Server-side wait budget in seconds; valid only with `wait_for`.

get.description:
The slug-prefixed `GET /v1/orgs/:slug` returns the user's role; here the
key is treated as `Owner` (matches `OrgContext` semantics), so the
returned role is informational rather than a real per-user binding.

200.description: Organization bound to this API key

Action.description: Action to take on traffic matched by a [`Rule`] (or a policy default).

capacity.description: Maximum number of cached certificates. Default: 1000.

validity_hours.description: Certificate validity duration in hours. Default: 24.

allOf.description: The cloud sandbox specification, flattened onto the request body.

CloudCreateSandboxRequest.description:
Wire shape of a cloud sandbox create request body.

Flattens [`CloudSandboxSpec`] onto the request body, so on the wire this is
byte-identical to `CloudSandboxSpec`. The generated bindings surface the
flattened shape as `CloudSandboxSpec` directly.

CloudDiskImageFormat.description:
Disk image format for cloud disk-image sources. Twin of [`DiskImageFormat`]
with a snake_case wire.

oneOf.description: Any host (dangerous - the secret can be exfiltrated).

CloudHostPattern.description:
Host allowlist pattern for cloud secrets. Twin of [`HostPattern`], with the
domain's scalar variants normalized to `{ value }` for a uniform union.

CloudNetworkSpec.description:
Cloud network specification: a subset of the domain [`NetworkSpec`].
Interface overrides, host port mapping, DNS, TLS interception, and host-CA
trust are not part of this type. `deny_unknown_fields` - posting an omitted
field is an error, not a silent drop.

enabled.description: Whether networking is enabled for this sandbox.

oneOf.description: Write text content to a file.

mode.description: File permissions, such as `0o644`. `None` uses the default.

replace.description: Allow replacing a file that already exists in the rootfs.

oneOf.description: Write raw bytes to a file.

mode.description: File permissions, such as `0o644`. `None` uses the default.

replace.description: Allow replacing a file that already exists in the rootfs.

oneOf.description: Copy a file from the host into the rootfs.

replace.description: Allow replacing a file that already exists in the rootfs.

oneOf.description: Copy a directory from the host into the rootfs.

replace.description: Allow replacing files that already exist in the rootfs.

link.description: Absolute guest path where the symlink is created.

replace.description: Allow replacing a path that already exists in the rootfs.

mode.description: Directory permissions, such as `0o755`. `None` uses the default.

oneOf.description: Append content to an existing file.

path.description: Absolute guest path of the file to append to.

CloudPatch.description:
Rootfs patch applied before VM start. Twin of [`Patch`], internally tagged
with a snake_case `type` instead of the domain's external PascalCase tag.

CloudPullPolicy.description: Cloud pull policy. Twin of domain [`PullPolicy`] with a snake_case wire.

CloudRlimit.description: A POSIX resource limit. Twin of [`Rlimit`] using [`CloudRlimitResource`].

hard.description: Hard limit (ceiling, requires privileges to raise).

soft.description: Soft limit (can be raised up to the hard limit by the process).

CloudRlimitResource.description:
POSIX resource-limit identifiers. Twin of [`RlimitResource`] with a
snake_case wire.

CloudRootfsSource.description: Root filesystem source. The hosted cloud accepts OCI images only.

disk_size_mib.description: Writable disk size in MiB. Applies only to OCI root filesystems.

CloudSandboxRuntimeOptions.description:
Cloud guest runtime options: a subset of [`SandboxRuntimeOptions`]. The
hostname and the metrics-sampling knobs are not part of this type.
`deny_unknown_fields`.

CloudSandboxSpec.description: Cloud sandbox specification carried on create routes.

env.description: Environment variables visible to commands in the sandbox.

oneOf.description: Hand off PID 1 to a guest init binary after agentd setup.

labels.description: User-defined labels attached to the sandbox.

patches.description: Rootfs patches applied before VM start.

oneOf.description: CPU, memory, and user-facing disk resources.

rlimits.description: Sandbox-wide resource limits inherited by guest processes.

CloudSecretEntry.description: A single cloud secret entry. Twin of domain [`SecretEntry`].

allowed_hosts.description: Hosts allowed to receive this secret.

env_var.description: Environment variable name exposed to the sandbox.

injection.description: Where the secret may be injected.

oneOf.description: Per-secret violation action overriding the config default.

placeholder.description: Placeholder the sandbox sees instead of the real value.

require_tls_identity.description: Require verified TLS identity before substituting (default: true).

oneOf.description: Host-side source resolved into `value` at spawn time.

value.description: The secret value (empty when `source` carries a reference instead).

oneOf.description: Read from a host environment variable at apply time.
Read from a host-side secret store reference.

CloudSecretSource.description: Host-side source for a cloud secret. Twin of [`SecretSource`].

CloudSecretsConfig.description: Secret-injection config for the cloud API. Twin of domain [`SecretsConfig`].

on_violation.description: Default action when a placeholder leaks to a disallowed host.

oneOf.description: Forward the request with the placeholder unchanged for matching hosts.

hosts.description: Hosts for which the placeholder passes through unchanged.

CloudViolationAction.description:
Action on a cloud secret violation. Twin of [`ViolationAction`], with
`Passthrough`'s host list normalized to a `hosts` field.

oneOf.description: Bind mount a host directory into the guest.

host.description: Host directory to bind into the guest.

host_permissions.description: Host permission policy applied to the mount.

oneOf.description: Mount a named volume into the guest.

host_permissions.description: Host permission policy applied to the mount.

oneOf.description: Temporary filesystem backed by guest memory.
Mount a disk image file as a virtio-blk device at a guest path.

host.description: Host path to the disk image file.

CloudVolumeMount.description:
Cloud volume mount. Internal-tagged mirror of the domain [`VolumeMount`];
the transient `create` field is not carried on the wire.

allOf.description:
The microsandbox sandbox specification - image, resources, runtime, env,
mounts, network, lifecycle - flattened onto the request body.

registry.description:
Registry-credential selection for the image pull. Absent ⇒ `Auto`
(infer the credential from the image's registry host). Credential-only:
this never changes *where* the image is pulled from - the image string
controls that - only *which* stored credential, if any, is presented.

slug.description:
Optional globally-unique slug - the SSH username token. Lowercase
letters, digits, and single hyphens; 3-63 chars. Omitted ⇒ a dictionary
slug is generated. Must be globally unique (409 on conflict).

CreateSandboxRequest.description:
What the user sends in `POST /v1/sandboxes`.

The body *is* a microsandbox [`CloudSandboxSpec`] - carried verbatim through the
shared [`CloudCreateSandboxRequest`] envelope (flattened onto the wire) so it
can never drift from the cross-repo contract - plus the cloud-only fields
that have no place in the shared spec: the globally-unique SSH `slug` and the
registry-credential selection. (Writable-disk size now lives in the spec's
`resources.disk_size_mib`.)

capacity_gib.description:
Optional per-volume storage cap in GiB (#496). Omitted/`null` = no
per-volume limit (the org's plan cap still governs). Must be `>= 1` and
`<= the org's storage cap`.

labels.description:
User-defined labels (free-form string map). Omitted = none. Keys using a
platform-reserved prefix are rejected.

name.description:
Volume name, unique within the org. Lowercase alphanumeric with single
internal hyphens (e.g. `team-ml`). Creates a `managed` volume; the host
disk is system-provisioned and has no name.

oneOf.description:
Physical backing for the volume. Omitted = `block` (the default and only
value today).
Domain suffix - the apex and any subdomain of it.

domain_suffix.description: Domain suffix - the apex and any subdomain of it.

Destination.description:
Traffic destination filter for a [`Rule`].

The `Cidr`, `Domain`, and `DomainSuffix` leaves carry their canonical
string form (e.g. `"10.0.0.0/8"`, `"example.com"`); the local network
engine re-parses and validates them into its richer internal types at
load time.

DestinationGroup.description: Pre-defined destination category for a [`Destination::Group`] match.

DiskImageFormat.description: Disk image format for virtio-blk root filesystems and volume mounts.

DnsConfig.description: DNS interception and filtering settings. Carried in [`NetworkSpec::dns`].

nameservers.description:
Upstream nameservers as `IP`, `IP:PORT`, `HOST`, or `HOST:PORT`
strings. Empty falls back to the host's `/etc/resolv.conf`.

rebind_protection.description: Whether DNS-rebinding protection is enabled. Default: true.

ErrorResponse.description: Error envelope returned by every non-2xx response.

details.description: Optional structured context for the error.

oneOf.description:
The authorized SSH key that authenticated a front-door session. The
principal SSH actually proves at connect is the *key*, not a person -
the scope-only model (D8) doesn't bind a key to a user (a global key may
be shared), so the session is attributed to the key (label + fingerprint),
while whoever registered it rides the event payload as `added_by`.

label.description: Human label set at registration (e.g. `alice-laptop`), if any.

EventActor.description:
Maximum total length, in characters, of the truncated `command` field in
Immutable actor snapshot stored alongside an event.

EventResponse.description: A single audit/lifecycle event returned by the API.

cmd.description:
Init binary: absolute path inside the guest rootfs, or the literal `auto`.

Always a Linux-style `/`-separated path - never build it with host OS path APIs, whose semantics diverge on Windows (`\` separators, `/sbin/init` treated as relative).

env.description: Extra env vars merged on top of the inherited env.

HostPermissions.description:
Host permission propagation policy for a virtiofs-backed volume mount.

Serializes/deserializes as the lowercase variant name (`"private"`, `"mirror"`) to align with the CLI and NAPI spellings.

InterceptCaConfig.description: Certificate authority configuration for TLS interception.

cert_path.description:
Path to an existing CA certificate PEM file. If `None`, a CA is
auto-generated and persisted.

key_path.description:
Path to an existing CA private key PEM file. If `None`, a key is
auto-generated and persisted.

InterfaceOverrides.description:
Optional guest interface overrides. Unset fields are derived from the
sandbox slot by the local network engine. Carried in
[`NetworkSpec::interface`].

ipv4_address.description: Guest IPv4 address (e.g. `172.16.0.2`). Default: derived from slot.

ipv4_pool.description: Guest IPv4 pool CIDR (e.g. `"172.16.0.0/12"`). Default: derived from slot.

ipv6_address.description: Guest IPv6 address. Default: derived from slot.

ipv6_pool.description: Guest IPv6 pool CIDR. Default: derived from slot.

mac.description: Guest MAC address as six octets. Default: derived from slot.

MessageResponse.description: Simple message response for operations without a body.

MountOptions.description: Guest mount behavior shared by every volume mount kind.

nodev.description: Whether device files on the mount are ignored.

noexec.description:
Whether direct execution from the mount is disabled.

This prevents `execve` of binaries or scripts located on the mount. Interpreters can still read files from the mount, for example `sh /mnt/script.sh`, because the interpreter itself executes from a different filesystem.

nosuid.description: Whether setuid and setgid privilege elevation from files on the mount is ignored.

readonly.description:
Whether the mount is read-only.

Guest writes fail with the kernel's read-only filesystem behavior. Virtiofs-backed mounts also reject writes on the host-side filesystem server as defense in depth.

NetworkPolicy.description:
Egress/ingress network policy: an ordered [`Rule`] list plus a
per-direction default [`Action`]. Carried in [`NetworkSpec::policy`].

default_egress.description: Default action for egress traffic matching no rule. Default: `Deny`.

default_ingress.description: Default action for ingress traffic matching no rule. Default: `Deny`.

rules.description: Ordered rules, evaluated first-match-wins per direction.

OrgMemberResponse.description: Member with joined user profile data - repository read view.

OrgWithRole.description: Organization with the requesting user's role included.

PaginatedEventResponse.description: Wrapper for paginated event responses (needed for OpenAPI schema generation).

PoolUsage.description:
An org's monthly pool usage against its hard-cap pools - the shared home of
the exhaustion predicates, whether read per-org (embedded in `QuotaUsage`)
or in the quota monitor's batched sweep (`OrgPoolUsage`).

hard_cap.description:
Whether the plan hard-stops at its included pools (no overflow).
DERIVED (not a stored column): true iff the resolved plan is unpriced -
an unpriced plan has no overage path, so its pools become walls.

included_vcpu_hours.description:
Included vCPU-hours/month; `None` = unlimited. On `hard_cap` plans this
is the compute wall; on priced plans, usage beyond it is metered overage.

memory_gib_hours_used.description: Memory GiB-hours consumed this billing month (compute-on-read from `sandbox_runs`).

vcpu_hours_used.description: vCPU-hours consumed this billing month (compute-on-read from `sandbox_runs`).

PortProtocol.description: Transport protocol for a published port.

PortRange.description: Inclusive guest-side port range for a [`Rule`] match.

PublishedPortSpec.description: A published port mapping between host and guest.

host_bind.description: Host address to bind. Defaults to loopback.

included_disk_gib_hours.description: Included writable-disk GiB-hours/month (display/billing only - never a wall).

is_suspended.description: Whether sandbox usage has been manually suspended for the organization.

max_disk_size_mib_per_sandbox.description: Maximum writable disk size (MiB) per sandbox.

max_sandboxes.description: Maximum total sandboxes the org can have.

max_uptime_minutes_per_sandbox.description: Maximum uptime per sandbox (minutes), if set.

pool_exhausted.description:
Snapshot of [`PoolUsage::pool_exhausted`] at read time, for API
consumers - true when this org's sandboxes are being stopped and starts
refused.

total_sandboxes.description: Total sandboxes (all states) for the org.

QuotaUsage.description:
Resolved quota limits and current usage for an organization.

Limits are resolved via COALESCE: per-org override > plan. Every limit is
`Option`: `None` = unlimited (counts/budgets) or the system/node max
(per-sandbox vcpu/memory/disk). There is no magic 0.

oneOf.description: Infer a stored credential from the image registry host.

credential_id.description: Id of a configured `OrgRegistryCredential` belonging to the org.

oneOf.description: Use plaintext credentials for this create-and-start operation only.

password.description: Registry password or access token. Always redacted from `Debug`.

RegistrySelection.description:
Registry credential selection accepted on sandbox-create requests.

`Inline` is deliberately request-only: its plaintext fields must be vaulted
before persistence and must never enter the sandbox row, a worker launch
definition, a log, or an API response.

hard.description: Hard limit (ceiling, requires privileges to raise).

soft.description: Soft limit (can be raised up to hard limit by the process).

Rule.description:
A single egress/ingress policy rule. Evaluated first-match-wins per
direction.

action.description: Action to take on a match.

ports.description: Guest-side port-range set; empty matches any port.

protocols.description: Protocol set; empty matches any protocol.

SandboxDailyUsage.description:
Compute usage for one sandbox on one UTC day, across both billed dimensions.

Computed on read from `sandbox_runs` (not from the billing provider) - open runs accrue
against `now()`, so a *running* sandbox shows live usage. Quantities are
seconds-based (vCPU-seconds, MiB-seconds), the same units the metering events
carry; display converts to vCPU-hours / GiB-hours. Sum over days for a
sandbox's period total; sum over sandboxes for the daily series.

day.description: UTC midnight of the day this usage falls in.

disk_mib_seconds.description:
Σ(overlap_secs × disk_mib) for this sandbox on this day - provisioned
writable disk billed on the same GiB-seconds basis while the sandbox runs.

mem_mib_seconds.description: Σ(overlap_secs × mem_mib) for this sandbox on this day.

vcpu_seconds.description: Σ(overlap_secs × vcpus) for this sandbox on this day.

SandboxIdentity.description:
Minimal sandbox display info - the directory that turns the `sandbox_id`s in
a [`UsageBreakdown`]'s rows into human labels without a second round-trip.

SandboxLogLevel.description: Runtime log verbosity for sandbox specs.

SandboxMountResponse.description:
A mount, projected for the user: guest path + options, never the resolved
volume id / source.

SandboxNetworkResponse.description: Network config, projected for the user. Secrets drop their vault path.

ephemeral.description:
Whether the sandbox is ephemeral.

Ephemeral sandboxes are one-off: the host runtime that owns the
process removes the persisted DB row and on-disk state when the VM
reaches a terminal status, and other host runtimes opportunistically
clean up ephemeral leftovers from runtimes that died before they
could self-clean. Defaults to `false` (persistent); named and created
sandboxes stay inspectable and restartable after they stop.

idle_timeout_secs.description: Idle timeout in seconds. `None` = no idle detection.

max_duration_secs.description: Hard cap on total sandbox lifetime in seconds. `None` = run forever.

SandboxResponse.description:
The API view of a [`Sandbox`]: an explicit allowlist of user-facing fields.
Internal columns (registry selection, sync bookkeeping, resolved refs) never
appear; the resolved spec surfaces only as the curated [`SandboxSpecResponse`].

last_failure_message.description: Human-readable reason for the last failure.

oneOf.description: Curated projection of the resolved spec; absent until resolved.

started_at.description: Latest run's start time; `null` if the sandbox has never run.

stopped_at.description: Latest run's stop time; `null` while open or never run.

SandboxRuntimeOptions.description: Guest runtime options for a sandbox.

metrics_sample_interval_ms.description: Metrics sampling interval in milliseconds. `None` disables sampling.

scripts.description: Named scripts available inside the guest.

shell.description: Default shell for scripts and interactive sessions.

SandboxSecretResponse.description:
A network secret, projected for the user: the env var, placeholder, and its
allow-list / injection policy. The value isn't in the resolved spec at all,
and the OpenBao vault path is never exposed.

SandboxSpecResponse.description:
A curated, user-facing projection of a sandbox's resolved spec. Built from
[`ResolvedSandboxSpec`]; omits every internal resolution (secret
values/vault paths, volume ids).

image.description: OCI image reference the sandbox boots; `null` for a non-OCI rootfs.

mounts.description: Volume mounts - guest path + options only; volume ids omitted.

network.description: Network config - secret values/vault paths omitted.

SandboxStatusReason.description:
Why a submitted sandbox is still waiting for placement on a worker. Only
meaningful while `status` is `starting`.

SandboxWaitFor.description: Lifecycle state an opt-in create request may wait to observe.

ScopedUpstreamCaCert.description: A CA certificate PEM file trusted only for matching upstream hosts.

path.description: Path to the CA certificate PEM file.

pattern.description: Host pattern this CA applies to. Supports exact hosts and `*.suffix` wildcards.

ScopedVerifyUpstream.description: An upstream certificate verification override for matching hosts.

pattern.description: Host pattern this override applies to. Supports exact hosts and `*.suffix` wildcards.

verify.description: Whether to verify matching upstream server certificates.

SecretInjection.description: Where in the HTTP request a secret can be injected.

basic_auth.description: Substitute in HTTP Basic Auth (default: true).

body.description:
Substitute in request body (default: false).

Fixed-length HTTP/1 bodies up to 16 MiB update `Content-Length`;
larger fixed-length bodies are blocked. Chunked HTTP/1 bodies are
decoded and re-encoded with fresh chunk sizes. Encoded bodies pass
through unchanged. HTTP/2 DATA-frame body substitution is not
supported; matching body placeholders are blocked.

query_params.description: Substitute in URL query parameters (default: false).

StatVirtualization.description:
Stat virtualization policy for a virtiofs-backed volume mount.

Serializes/deserializes as the lowercase variant name (`"strict"`, `"relaxed"`, `"off"`) so persisted JSON aligns with the CLI grammar (`stat-virt=strict|relaxed|off`) and the NAPI string contract.

StorageBreakdown.description:
Per-volume durable-storage usage breakdown for an org over a window:
per-(volume, day) rows plus a directory of the volumes they reference. The
storage sibling of [`UsageBreakdown`](crate::UsageBreakdown). Deleted volumes'
accruals persist, so `rows` may reference `volume_id`s absent from `volumes`;
the client labels those as deleted.

StorageDailyUsage.description:
Durable-storage usage for one volume on one UTC day, computed on read from
`storage_accruals`. `mib_seconds` is Σ(used_mib × overlap_seconds) over the
day; display converts to GiB-hours or an average GiB. Sum over days for a
volume's period total; sum over volumes for the daily series. The storage
sibling of [`SandboxDailyUsage`](crate::SandboxDailyUsage).

day.description: UTC midnight of the day this usage falls in.

mib_seconds.description: Σ(used_mib × overlap_seconds) for this volume on this day.

TlsConfig.description:
TLS interception configuration. Carried in [`NetworkSpec::tls`](NetworkSpec).

The local network engine terminates TCP at its in-process stack, so TLS MITM
is handled by proxy tasks - these fields configure which ports/domains are
intercepted and how the interception CA is sourced.

block_quic_on_intercept.description:
Drop UDP to intercepted ports when TLS interception is active, forcing
QUIC traffic to fall back to TCP/TLS.

bypass.description: Domains to bypass (no MITM). Supports exact match and `*.suffix` wildcards.

intercept_ca.description:
Interception CA configuration. The TLS proxy uses this CA to sign
per-domain certs it presents to the guest during interception.

intercepted_ports.description: TCP ports subject to TLS interception (default: `[443]`).

scoped_upstream_ca_cert.description: Host-scoped CA certificate PEM files to trust for upstream server verification.

upstream_ca_cert.description: CA certificate PEM files to trust for upstream server verification.

verify_upstream.description: Whether to verify the upstream server's TLS certificate.

UpdateSandboxRequest.description:
Request body for `PATCH /v1/orgs/:slug/sandboxes/:id` - rename a sandbox.
Each field updates only when present; omit one to leave it unchanged.
`name` is the per-org display label; `slug` is the globally-unique SSH
address handle (changing it breaks existing `ssh <old-slug>@msb.run`).

name.description: New per-org display name. Omit to leave unchanged.

slug.description: New globally-unique slug (the SSH username token). Omit to leave unchanged.

UpdateVolumeRequest.description:
PATCH /v1/orgs/{slug}/volumes/{id} - update the cap and/or labels (#496).

Every field is independently optional: an **omitted** field is left unchanged.
`capacity_gib` uses the double-`Option` distinction - omit to leave as-is,
explicit `null` to clear the cap, a number to set it.

capacity_gib.description:
New per-volume storage cap in GiB. Omitted = unchanged; `null` = clear the
cap (back to no per-volume limit); a value sets it. A set value must be
`>= 1` and `<= the org's storage cap`.

labels.description:
Replacement label set. Omitted = unchanged; an object replaces the labels
wholesale (an empty object clears them). Reserved-prefix keys are rejected.

UsageBreakdown.description:
Compute-on-read usage breakdown for an org over a window: per-(sandbox, day)
quantity rows plus a directory of the sandboxes they reference. The frontend
groups `rows` by sandbox (for the per-sandbox table) or by day (for the
chart) and labels them via `sandboxes`.

UsageDailyPoint.description:
One day's metered quantity for a single billable metric - the unit of a
usage time-series chart. Cost is intentionally omitted: invoices are
period-aggregated, so a per-day dollar figure would have to be derived.

metric.description: Billable-metric name this quantity belongs to.

UsageLineItem.description: A single line item in a usage summary.

UsageSummary.description: Usage summary from the billing provider.

daily.description:
Per-day metered quantities for charting. One entry per (day, metric).
Empty when no daily series is available (e.g. provider error).

line_items.description: Period-aggregated breakdown - one entry per billable metric / charge.

projected_spend_cents.description:
End-of-period spend projection: `total_cents` linearly extrapolated over
the billing period. Equals `total_cents` when the period can't be
extrapolated (no future end, or zero elapsed). Never below `total_cents`.

storage_gib.description:
Current durable-storage usage (GiB) for the org, from the latest hourly
reading. `None` when storage hasn't been sampled (juicefs-ops disabled or
no volumes). Drives the storage allowance bar; cost is in `line_items`.

VolumeIdentity.description:
Minimal volume display info - the directory that turns the `volume_id`s in a
[`StorageBreakdown`](crate::StorageBreakdown)'s rows into human labels. A
deleted volume's accruals outlive its row, so a breakdown may reference ids
absent from this directory; the client labels those as deleted.

VolumeKind.description:
What kind of volume this is - its storage source / role. The host volume is
the org's single shared "host disk"; managed volumes are user-created, named,
platform-provisioned (JuiceFS over our object store). (A future `External`
variant - bring-your-own S3/GCS - is intentionally out of scope for now.)

VolumeResponse.description:
Volume metadata returned in list/create responses. The GCS storage path is
derived (not stored) and never exposed.

capacity_bytes.description:
The volume's configured per-volume storage cap in bytes, or `null` when
no cap is set (#496). Derived from the stored `capacity_gib` (the user's
configured intent) - the effective ceiling is `min(this, org cap)`.

kind.description:
`host` - the org's shared host disk (not deletable); `managed` - a
user-created named volume.

labels.description: User-defined labels (empty object when none set).

name.description:
User-facing name. `null` for the host volume (it has no name; it's
identified by `kind`).

storage.description: How the volume is physically backed (`block` today).

used_bytes.description:
Bytes currently used under this volume's subtree. `null` when usage is
unavailable - the usage service is disabled or unreachable (list degrades
gracefully rather than failing) - or on create/delete, which don't sample
it.

VolumeType.description:
How a volume is physically backed - distinct from [`VolumeKind`] (ownership).
Every volume is `Block` today; the enum exists so future backings can be added
(and reported to the SDK) without another schema change.

api_key.description: Organization API key (msb_…) - org-scoped programmatic access.
